name: pr-review
description: On a pull request, run staticcheck (lint), gosec (SAST), govulncheck (SCA) and Trivy (container: Dockerfile misconfig, dependency CVEs, leaked secrets — in its own sandbox), post their results as markdown-table PR comments, then run a code review and a security review whose findings (issues, vulns, and recommendations) are posted as further PR comments. Trigger with inputs {repo, number, ref, sha}: repo is the git-factory repo NAME under ops/, number the PR number, ref the PR source branch, sha its head commit. The reviewers read the tree at the PR head plus the scan/ reports and write a markdown findings table which a Go poster (embedded, go-run in the scan image) posts via git-factory's PR comments API.

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: git-factory repo name within the namespace

inputs.name: refine_iter
inputs.description: internal: refine cycle counter (0 first pass, 1 = last chance before human hold)

with.run: set -e; export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; git clone -q "$GIT_URL" /workspace; cd /workspace; git checkout -q "${inputs.ref}" 2>/dev/null || git checkout -q "${inputs.sha}" 2>/dev/null || true; echo cloned; git log --oneline -1

export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/gocache/build GOMODCACHE=/gocache/mod GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false && mkdir -p /gocache/build /gocache/mod; cd /workspace && mkdir -p scan; (go run honnef.co/go/tools/cmd/staticcheck@latest ./... > scan/lint.txt 2>&1 || true); (go run github.com/securego/gosec/v2/cmd/gosec@latest -quiet -fmt=json -out=scan/sast.json ./... 2>/dev/null || true); (go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@latest ./... > scan/sca.txt 2>&1 || true); echo scan-done; ls -la scan

export HOME=/tmp; cd /workspace; if [ ! -f web/package.json ]; then echo 'no web/ — skipping web scans'; exit 0; fi; mkdir -p /workspace/scan; cd web; npm install --package-lock-only --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; npx --yes -p typescript tsc --noEmit --pretty false > /workspace/scan/web-lint.txt 2>&1 || true; npx --yes @biomejs/biome@latest lint . >> /workspace/scan/web-lint.txt 2>&1 || true; npm audit --json > /workspace/scan/web-sca.json 2>/dev/null || true; echo web-scan-done; ls -la /workspace/scan

export TRIVY_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/trivy-cache; mkdir -p /workspace/scan /tmp/trivy-cache; cd /workspace; trivy fs --scanners vuln,misconfig,secret --no-progress --format table --output scan/container.txt . 2>/tmp/trivy.log || { echo 'trivy did not complete (log tail):' > scan/container.txt; tail -8 /tmp/trivy.log >> scan/container.txt; }; echo container-scan-done; ls -la scan; echo '--- container.txt (head) ---'; head -40 scan/container.txt

with.task: Review the change on pull request #${inputs.number} for quality.
Review the change on pull request #${inputs.number} for security.

with.run:
set -e; export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false; mkdir -p /gocache/build /gocache/mod /tmp/ext; export GOCACHE=/gocache/build GOMODCACHE=/gocache/mod; echo '' | base64 -d > /tmp/ext/main.go; cd /tmp/ext && printf 'module ext

go 1.25
' > go.mod; tasks=$(go run . /workspace/review-security.md /workspace/review-quality.md /workspace/findings-go.json /workspace/findings-web.json /workspace/tasks-web.json); web=$(cat /workspace/tasks-web.json 2>/dev/null || echo "[]"); export tasks web; echo "tasks=$tasks"; echo "tasks_web=$web"

set +e; export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false; cd /workspace; mkdir -p /workspace/.prreview /workspace/.prreview-pf/out; TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#'); GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; REPO='${inputs.repo}'; RID=$(curl -s --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 20 --retry 2 "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" | tr '{' '\n' | grep "\"name\":\"$REPO\"" | sed -E 's/.*\"id\":\"([^\"]+)\".*/\1/' | head -1); echo '' | base64 -d > /workspace/.prreview/poster.go; [ -s /workspace/findings-go.json ] || echo '[]' > /workspace/findings-go.json; [ -s /workspace/findings-web.json ] || echo '[]' > /workspace/findings-web.json; go run /workspace/.prreview/poster.go /workspace/scan /workspace/.prreview-pf/out /workspace/findings-go.json - /workspace/findings-web.json - /workspace/review-quality.md /workspace/review-security.md; fail=0; for f in /workspace/.prreview-pf/out/comment-*.json; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/resp --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 20 --retry 2 --retry-delay 1 --retry-all-errors -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$GF/repos/$RID/pulls/${inputs.number}/comments" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d @"$f" || echo 000); echo "posted $f -> $code"; case "$code" in 2*) ;; *) fail=1;; esac; done; [ "$fail" = 0 ] || echo 'warning: one or more comments failed to post (non-fatal; review verdict + gate still proceed)'; echo post-findings-done; exit 0
echo 'go fixers complete; starting web fixers'

set -e; export HOME=/tmp; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; cd /workspace; mkdir -p /workspace/.preserve; cp -f review-quality.md review-security.md /workspace/.preserve/ 2>/dev/null || true; git fetch -q "$GIT_URL" "${inputs.ref}"; git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD; cp -f /workspace/.preserve/review-quality.md /workspace/.preserve/review-security.md /workspace/ 2>/dev/null || true; echo "refreshed to $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"

set +e; export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false; cd /workspace; mkdir -p /workspace/.prreview /workspace/.prreview/out; TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#'); GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; REPO='${inputs.repo}'; RID=$(curl -s --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 20 --retry 2 "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" | tr '{' '\n' | grep "\"name\":\"$REPO\"" | sed -E 's/.*\"id\":\"([^\"]+)\".*/\1/' | head -1); printf '%s' '${steps.fix.output}' > /workspace/.prreview/out-go.json 2>/dev/null || echo '[]' > /workspace/.prreview/out-go.json; printf '%s' '${steps.fix-web.output}' > /workspace/.prreview/out-web.json 2>/dev/null || echo '[]' > /workspace/.prreview/out-web.json; [ -s /workspace/findings-go.json ] || echo '[]' > /workspace/findings-go.json; [ -s /workspace/findings-web.json ] || echo '[]' > /workspace/findings-web.json; go run /workspace/.prreview/poster.go /workspace/scan /workspace/.prreview/out /workspace/findings-go.json /workspace/.prreview/out-go.json /workspace/findings-web.json /workspace/.prreview/out-web.json /workspace/review-quality.md /workspace/review-security.md; fail=0; for f in /workspace/.prreview/out/comment-*.json; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/resp --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 20 --retry 2 --retry-delay 1 --retry-all-errors -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$GF/repos/$RID/pulls/${inputs.number}/comments" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d @"$f" || echo 000); echo "posted $f -> $code"; case "$code" in 2*) ;; *) fail=1;; esac; done; [ "$fail" = 0 ] || echo 'warning: one or more comments failed to post (non-fatal; review verdict + gate still proceed)'; echo report-done; exit 0

with.task: Summarise pull request #${inputs.number} and give a merge recommendation.

with.run:
set +e; export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; cd /workspace; NUM='${inputs.number}'; TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#'); GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; REPO='${inputs.repo}'; RID=$(curl -s --max-time 30 --retry 3 "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" | tr '{' '
' | grep ""name":"$REPO"" | sed -E 's/.*"id":"([^"]+)".*/\1/' | head -1); LASTTAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 --match 'v*' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$LASTTAG" ]; then VBASE=${LASTTAG#v}; RANGE="$LASTTAG..HEAD"; else VBASE=0.0.0; B=$(git merge-base origin/dev HEAD 2>/dev/null || git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD | tail -1); RANGE="$B..HEAD"; fi; MAJ=${VBASE%%.*}; r=${VBASE#*.}; MIN=${r%%.*}; PAT=${r#*.}; S=$(git log $RANGE --format='%s'); if printf '%s' "$S" | grep -qE '^[a-z]+(\(.+\))?!:|BREAKING CHANGE'; then MAJ=$((MAJ+1)); MIN=0; PAT=0; elif printf '%s' "$S" | grep -qE '^feat(\(.+\))?:'; then MIN=$((MIN+1)); PAT=0; elif printf '%s' "$S" | grep -qE '^fix(\(.+\))?:'; then PAT=$((PAT+1)); fi; VER="v$MAJ.$MIN.$PAT"; git log $RANGE --format='%H%x1f%s%x1f%b%x1e' > /tmp/commits.raw; mkdir -p /tmp/rn; echo '' | base64 -d > /tmp/rn/main.go; (cd /tmp/rn && printf 'module rn

go 1.25
' > go.mod && go run . /tmp/commits.raw "$VER") > /tmp/changelog.md; { [ -f SUMMARY.md ] && { cat SUMMARY.md; printf '

---

'; }; cat /tmp/changelog.md; } > /tmp/rel.md; echo '' | base64 -d > /tmp/main.go; mkdir -p /tmp/jw && mv /tmp/main.go /tmp/jw/ && cd /tmp/jw && printf 'module jw

go 1.25
' > go.mod && go run . /tmp/rel.md > /tmp/rel.json; cd /workspace; [ -n "$RID" ] && [ -n "$NUM" ] && { code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/resp --max-time 60 --retry 3 -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$GF/repos/$RID/pulls/$NUM/comments" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d @/tmp/rel.json || echo 000); echo "release comment ($VER) -> $code"; } || echo 'no RID/NUM -- skipping release comment'; exit 0

steps.name: gate
steps.description: Deterministic auto-merge: merge to dev only on a clean pr-summary MERGE verdict; nudges/hold stay for a human. Non-fatal.

with.run:
set +e
export HOME=/tmp
git config --global --add safe.directory '*'
cd /workspace
NUM='${inputs.number}'; REPO='${inputs.repo}'; RITER='${inputs.refine_iter}'
[ -z "$RITER" ] && RITER=0
TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#')
GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002
verdict=unknown; merged=false
i=0; while [ "$(timeout 12 curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$GF/healthz" 2>/dev/null)" = "000" ]; do i=$((i+1)); [ "$i" -ge 10 ] && break; sleep 5; done
if [ -f SUMMARY.md ]; then v=$(sed -n '/## Recommendation/,$p' SUMMARY.md | sed '1d' | grep -m1 -oE 'MERGE WITH NUDGES|MERGE|HOLD'); [ -n "$v" ] && verdict="$v"; fi
echo "gate: verdict=[$verdict] refine_iter=$RITER" 1>&2
if [ "$verdict" = "MERGE" ] || { [ "$verdict" = "MERGE WITH NUDGES" ] && [ "${RITER:-0}" -ge 1 ]; }; then
  RID=$(curl -s --max-time 30 --retry 3 "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" | tr '{' '\n' | grep "\"name\":\"$REPO\"" | sed -E 's/.*\"id\":\"([^\"]+)\".*/\1/' | head -1)
  if [ -n "$RID" ]; then
    CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/m -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 30 --retry 3 -X POST "$GF/repos/$RID/pulls/$NUM/merge" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"message":"auto-merge: clean pr-review (MERGE)"}')
    case "$CODE" in 200|201|204) merged=true; echo "gate: auto-merged PR #$NUM" 1>&2;; *) echo "gate: merge failed HTTP $CODE" 1>&2; cat /tmp/m 1>&2;; esac
  fi
fi
refine_iter="$RITER"
export verdict merged refine_iter
echo "verdict=$verdict"
echo "merged=$merged"
echo "refine_iter=$refine_iter"

with.task: Triage the residual pr-review findings for PR #${inputs.number} and write DECISION.json.

with.run:
set +e; cd /workspace
raw=$(cat DECISION.json 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ')
decision=$(printf '%s' "$raw" | sed -E 's/.*"decision"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([a-zA-Z]+)".*/\1/')
case "$decision" in merge|autofix|human) ;; *) decision=human;; esac
echo "judge decision=$decision (raw: $raw)" 1>&2
export decision
echo "decision=$decision"

set +e; export HOME=/tmp; cd /workspace
NUM='${inputs.number}'; REPO='${inputs.repo}'
TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#')
GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002
RID=$(curl -s --max-time 30 --retry 3 "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" | tr '{' '\n' | grep "\"name\":\"$REPO\"" | sed -E 's/.*\"id\":\"([^\"]+)\".*/\1/' | head -1)
[ -n "$RID" ] || { echo 'merge-nudges: no repo id' 1>&2; exit 1; }
printf '%s' '{"body":"## \u2705 Auto-merged with deferred nudges\n\nThe pr-review judge assessed the residual findings as non-blocking nits and merged this PR. See the review comments above for the deferred follow-ups."}' > /tmp/c.json
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'nudge-comment %{http_code}\n' --max-time 30 -X POST "$GF/repos/$RID/pulls/$NUM/comments" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d @/tmp/c.json 1>&2
CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/m -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 30 --retry 3 -X POST "$GF/repos/$RID/pulls/$NUM/merge" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"message":"auto-merge: pr-review judge (nits deferred)"}')
echo "merge-nudges: merge PR #$NUM HTTP $CODE" 1>&2
case "$CODE" in 200|201|204) exit 0;; *) cat /tmp/m 1>&2; exit 1;; esac

echo 'pr-review: HELD PR #${inputs.number} for a human — automated refine could not converge (see the review comments).' 1>&2
exit 1
